title: EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN NY Session Close Restriction (InpNYClose 18→17)
research_question: Does restricting the NY session close from 18:00 to 17:00 server time eliminate the toxic 17:00 entry hour on EURUSD M30 and shift 2026 UNSEEN net profit from negative to positive?
hypothesis: Reducing InpNYClose from 18 to 17 will eliminate the 12 trades entered during the 17:00 hour (which suffered 33.3% win rate and -$487.20 net loss in EXP-0067), improving net profit from -$289.77 to approximately +$197.43 without reducing profitable session coverage.

facts: In EXP-0067 (EURUSD M30 2026 UNSEEN, InpRequire618Rejection=true, InpLondonOpen=8), the strategy recorded -$289.77 net profit across 65 trades with PF 0.83.
Forensic hourly deal analysis of EXP-0067 reveals 12 trades entered during the 17:00 hour with 33.3% win rate (4W / 8L) and -$487.20 net PnL — the single largest hourly loss pocket.
All other NY session hours (14:00-16:00) were 100% win rate with +$313.03 combined profit across 15 trades.
The 11:00 hour was the second toxic pocket (37.5% WR, -$334.93) but is within the London session window.
Thursday and Friday trades were 0% win rate (0W / 6L, -$592.50 combined) across the entire 2026 UNSEEN window.
inferences: The 17:00 hour represents the final hour of the NY session where EURUSD liquidity thins and price action becomes choppy, producing false breakout entries that consistently reverse.
Restricting InpNYClose to 17 eliminates 17:00 entries without affecting the profitable 14:00-16:00 NY core window.
The expected net profit recovery of approximately +$487.20 would shift EXP-0067 from -$289.77 to approximately +$197.43.

independent_variables.name: InpNYClose
independent_variables.rationale: Eliminates the toxic 17:00 entry hour where EURUSD liquidity thins and false breakouts produce 33.3% win rate and -$487.20 net loss.

assumptions: The 17:00 hour toxicity is structural (thin EURUSD liquidity, end-of-session chop) rather than coincidental to the 2026 sample.
Eliminating 17:00 entries does not materially reduce profitable NY session coverage because 14:00-16:00 carries the profitable NY trades.
expected_observations: Total trades decrease from 65 by approximately 12 (to ~53).
Net profit improves from -$289.77, potentially turning positive.
Profit Factor improves above 0.83 and potentially above 1.0.
falsification_conditions: Net profit does not improve beyond -$289.77.
